# geonames

R package for accessing the geonames.org API

Install from here using `devtools`:

- `install.packages("devtools")` – if you don’t have devtools yet
- [`require(devtools)`](https://devtools.r-lib.org/)
- `install.packages("rjson")` – gets this dependency from CRAN
- `install_github("ropensci/geonames")`

A version of this will be pushed to CRAN.

To enable all of the functions of this package, register for a
geonames.org username at <http://www.geonames.org/login/> and then
enable access to the geonames free webservices by clicking
<http://www.geonames.org/enablefreewebservice> Once that’s done, in your
`R` session, run `options(geonamesUsername="myusername")` to
authenticate with the webservice. More information about the parameters
for many of the functions in this package can be found here:
[http://www.geonames.org/export/ws-overview.html](http://www.geonames.org/export/ws-overview.md)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`GNcities()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNcities.md)
  : find cities
- [`GNcountryCode()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNcountryCode.md)
  : country code for location
- [`GNcountryInfo()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNcountryInfo.md)
  : country info
- [`GNcountrySubdivision()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNcountrySubdivision.md)
  : country code and subdivision
- [`GNearthquakes()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNearthquakes.md)
  : recent earthquakes
- [`GNfindNearByWeather()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNfindNearByWeather.md)
  : weather at location
- [`GNfindNearby()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNfindNearby.md)
  : nearby search
- [`GNfindNearbyPlaceName()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNfindNearbyPlaceName.md)
  : populated place search
- [`GNfindNearbyPostalCodes()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNfindNearbyPostalCodes.md)
  : find postal code
- [`GNfindNearbyStreets()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNfindNearbyStreets.md)
  : nearby street finding
- [`GNfindNearbyWikipedia()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNfindNearbyWikipedia.md)
  : nearby wikipedia entries
- [`GNfindNearestAddress()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNfindNearestAddress.md)
  : nearest address
- [`GNfindNearestIntersection()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNfindNearestIntersection.md)
  : nearest intersection
- [`GNgtopo30()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNgtopo30.md)
  : topo30 height
- [`GNneighbourhood()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNneighbourhood.md)
  : neighbourhood
- [`GNpostalCodeCountryInfo()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNpostalCodeCountryInfo.md)
  : postal code info
- [`GNpostalCodeLookup()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNpostalCodeLookup.md)
  : postal code lookup
- [`GNpostalCodeSearch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNpostalCodeSearch.md)
  : postal code search
- [`GNsearch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNsearch.md)
  : search geonames
- [`GNsrtm3()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNsrtm3.md)
  : srtm3 height
- [`GNtimezone()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNtimezone.md)
  : timezone for location
- [`GNweather()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNweather.md)
  : weather stations in box
- [`GNweatherIcao()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNweatherIcao.md)
  : ICAO weather station data
- [`GNwikipediaBoundingBox()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNwikipediaBoundingBox.md)
  : wikipedia articles in a box
- [`GNwikipediaSearch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/GNwikipediaSearch.md)
  : search wikipedia
- [`geonames`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/geonames.md)
  [`geonames-package`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/geonames.md)
  : Query the geonames web API for geographic data
- [`GNchildren()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/hierarchy.md)
  [`GNhierarchy()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/hierarchy.md)
  [`GNsiblings()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/hierarchy.md)
  [`GNneighbours()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/geonames/reference/hierarchy.md)
  : Admin area hierarchy
